parsed.explanation: The write-up itself states Part B is open: the pigeonhole gives a signed vector with |sum delta_i a_i| <= T_n S but the text explicitly flags that such a signed sum is 'NOT always realizable by cancel/chain ops' and gives {1,2} as a failing case; the fallback is labelled 'Empirics from prev session ... needs verification & proof'. No mirrored-cut/overlay construction realizing Sigma(S)-Sigma(T) with at most n cuts appears anywhere. Hence L3.2 (upper bound universal over Liu's divisions) is not established; only n=1,2,3 grid computations support it. Supplying it requires a new construction, not a local edit.
